name: codex-here
description: Open a focused Codex planning agent from exact `codex-here` comment markers.

codexHere.marker.description: Exact stripped comment body that should receive the CodeLens.

codexHere.promptFile.description: Project-local prompt file to include in launched Codex sessions.

codexHere.contextLines.description: Number of nearby lines to include before and after the marker.

codexHere.tmuxSession.description: Named tmux session used to host Codex Here windows.

codexHere.ghosttyExecutable.description: Ghostty executable used to attach to the tmux session.

codexHere.codexExecutable.description: Optional Codex executable override. Leave blank to auto-detect.

codexHere.extraCodexArgs.description: Extra arguments passed to Codex before the prompt.
